story_type: damaged spacecraft flies home empty after a micrometeoroid hit
hook: A space rock hit this ship. Its crew lost their ride home.
narration: Something small from space hit this Soyuz while it sat docked to the space station.
On December fourteenth, its radiator was damaged, and the spacecraft lost all of its coolant.
So Russia replaced it. A new Soyuz arrived in February to bring Frank Rubio and two cosmonauts home.
Only the section where a crew rides survives the fall back through the atmosphere. The rest burns up, along with any clue to where the rock hit.
On March twenty eighth, the damaged ship undocked with no one aboard, loaded with equipment the station no longer needed.
Springs pushed it free, then a burn twice as long as normal hurried it away from the station.
[short pause] Its braking burn came just fifty five minutes after undocking, instead of the usual two and a half hours.
outcome: Soyuz MS-22 landed on the steppe of Kazakhstan a few hours later, with no one inside.
title: Space rock hit their ride home
description:
On March 28, 2023, the damaged Soyuz MS-22 undocked from the International Space Station and returned to Earth uncrewed, landing in Kazakhstan. It lost its cooling in December, most likely from a micrometeoroid that ruptured its radiator.
